concerns.text: FR-001 (download resting‑state fMRI and MER data) is marked as **Not covered** in the plan’s FR/SC Coverage Map and no task in the implementation phases explicitly satisfies this requirement.

FR-002 (CPU‑only fMRIPrep preprocessing) is listed as **Not covered**; the plan only contains a placeholder task (0.3) that is pending raw fMRI availability and does not fulfill the functional requirement.
FR-003 (extraction of time‑series and Pearson FC matrices) is also marked **Not covered**; Phase 1 tasks depend on raw fMRI which is unavailable, so the functional requirement is unmet.
Task 0.0 creates a Data‑Gap Report for FR‑007, but FR‑007 does not exist in the specification; this introduces a plan element with no corresponding FR/SC, constituting over‑reach.
